groups.title: Launcher
groups.about: Most people want one of these. The launcher installs Kiln into the game and keeps your mods and profiles.

files.label: Windows installer
files.about: For Windows 10 and 11. Installs for your user and updates itself.

files.label: Linux AppImage
files.about: One file, no install: make it executable and run it. Updates itself.

files.label: Linux .deb package
files.about: For Debian, Ubuntu and Mint. Update it by installing the next package.

groups.title: Dedicated servers
groups.about: For people who run an Enshrouded dedicated server. Unzip the server pack into the server folder, also over FTP on a rented server. kilnctl and the systemd units are for a server you run yourself.

files.label: Server pack
files.about: Unzip it into the folder with enshrouded_server.exe. Nothing else to install.

files.label: kilnctl for Linux
files.about: Command line that installs the Kiln runtime, runs a server under Wine and backs it up.

files.label: kilnctl for Windows
files.about: Command line that installs the Kiln runtime into a game or server folder.

files.label: kiln@.service
files.about: systemd user unit that runs one kilnctl server. Put the server name after the @.

files.label: kiln-backup@.service
files.about: systemd user unit that backs up the savegame of one kilnctl server.

groups.title: Manual install
groups.about: For installing Kiln by hand, without the launcher. kilnctl, in Dedicated servers, installs this zip for you.

files.label: Kiln runtime
files.about: Kiln without the launcher. Install it with kilnctl, or by hand.

files.label: Install instructions
files.about: Step by step: the runtime on a game client or a server.
